Problem: Determine whether 7 can be smallest prime factor of repunit.

Solution:
S? 
1. Let Rn repunit = (10^n -1)/9.
2. Suppose 7|Rn. Since gcd(7,9)=1, 7|Rn iff 7|10^n-1, so 10^n ≡ 1 mod 7.
3. 10 ≡ 3 mod 7, so 3^n ≡ 1 mod 7.
4. Powers of 3 mod 7 show order 6, so 3^n≡1 iff 6|n. Therefore if 7|Rn then 6|n, in particular 3|n.
5. Reduce Rn mod 3: since 10≡1 mod3, Rn ≡ n mod3. Because 3|n, Rn≡0 mod3.
6. Therefore every repunit divisible by 7 also divisible by 3. Since 3<7, 7 cannot be smallest prime factor. Final No.
